$comment: Agentic Co design tokens, v1. tokens.css is the source of truth for anything that ships to a browser; this file mirrors it for tooling that cannot parse CSS. check-tokens.py proves the two agree — run it rather than trusting that they do.

paper.use: light ground; warm, never pure white

attest.use: gates and passing verdicts ONLY — never decorative

color.$note: attest/refuse are the ColorBrewer Dark2 pair, chosen so a pass/fail distinction survives colour-blindness.

font.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
font.$note: Prose argues; mono is the machine speaking. Gate kinds, commands, identifiers and verdicts are always mono.
